name: shareaplate
description: ShareAPlate: share surplus food with your community

scripts.setup: node backend/scripts/create-env.js && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm run db:seed --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start:prod: npm run db:migrate --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
